name: closeness_centrality
author: 7cc0c2d7
description: Ranks graph nodes by closeness centrality. Useful for identifying nodes that can reach other nodes in relatively few steps. Supports directed and undirected unweighted graphs. Returns the top_k nodes with their closeness scores.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many top results to return.
